sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head yellowish brown, slightly paler anteriorly; antennae smoky brown, yellowish brown at the base; mandibles pale reddish brown, paler at the base; pronotum pale yellow; abdomen and legs pale yellowish white. Pilosity sparse on the head; a few setae on the margins and disc of the pronotum; a few hairs on the anterior half of the postmentum. Head suboblong-oval, slightly longer than wide; 1.07–1.14 mm long to base of mandibles, 0.95–1.00 mm maximum width; width of mandible base 0.65–0.72 mm; ratio of maximum width to length about 0.9, ratio of mandible-base width to maximum width about 0.65. Antennae 15-segmented; segment 2 about twice as long as segment 3; segment 3 shortest. Labrum ligulate, anterior part rounded and pointed, each side with a row of hairs. Mandibles long and slender, tips weakly incurved; left mandible 0.74–0.78 mm long; ratio of mandible length to head length 0.691. Left mandible with a small forwardly directed tooth at the apical third; tooth 0.27–0.30 mm from the tip; ratio of tooth distance to mandible length 0.365. Minute tooth of the right mandible slightly below the level of the left mandibular tooth. Postmentum arched, sides slightly convex, slightly longer than wide, maximum width at the middle; 0.63–0.70 mm long, 0.39–0.44 mm maximum width. Pronotum saddle-shaped; anterior margin without a distinct notch, posterior margin weakly emarginate; 0.37–0.41 mm long, 0.65–0.68 mm wide.
